name: Kinetic Proficiency, Improved
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kinetic Proficiency.

Benefit(s): When you attack with an infusion which can be used as part of an attack action (such as devastating infusion or kinetic blade), the attack has the deadly, disarm, distracting, sunder, and trip weapon qualities.
